metadata.title: Ultimate GOA Food Series l People + Food + Culture + Adventure + Celebrations + GOA TOURISM
metadata.description:
Last month we were in the serene and surreal state of Goa to explore its vibrant food culture. In the fortnight long journey we came across some beautiful people, scrumptious food, festive fervour and picturesque locales. 

The cuisine over here is a potpourri of numerous cultural influences like that has existed over the centuries. With influences like that of the Portuguese, French, Konkan, Malabar etc. The Goan cuisine is a blend of native and the foreign food traditions. Moreover, the three main communities of Goa - Hindus, Muslims and Christians - have shaped it's culinary terrain. 

In this extensive series we will take you on an incredible and off beat gustatory journey that will make you fall in love with the 'Rome Of The East'.

SERIES BEGINS ON   6th JANUARY 2021.

#DFWinGoa #GoaFoodTour #GoaFood #Goancuisine #GoanFood #FoodTour #FoodWalks #TravelforFood #goastreetfood #walkwithanubhav


Thank you for watching! 
Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed!
